oil.when: 2005 with the Driver Information Center (DIC) buttons
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have been changed.
Press the fuel button on the Driver Information Center until the ENGINE OIL LIFE screen shows.
Press and hold the select button for about five seconds while ENGINE OIL LIFE is showing.
OIL LIFE RESET appears for about 10 seconds.
Start the vehicle. If the change engine oil light comes back on, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.
